title: Create Your First Genie Agent
brief: Build the Meridian Wealth & Distribution agent for real, on the objects you kept in Lab 7.
- Point it at 8 objects or fewer. Fewer is better; the docs advise five.
- Review the AI-suggested descriptions and reject the wrong ones. At least two are
wrong: one about what AUM means, one about the asset-class hierarchies.
- Write instructions, but keep them short. Anything you can settle in the data or in
a SQL expression does not belong in prose.
- Add 5 starter questions your audience would actually ask.
- Confirm all 5 return correct answers before you call it done.
Name the agent so it contains 'Wealth & Distribution'.

checks.name: The agent exists
checks.hint: Create it in the Genie UI, or with academy.create_agents().

checks.name: It carries 5 starter questions
checks.hint: Starter questions are how a new user learns what the agent is for.

checks.name: It has instructions
checks.hint: Say what the agent is for and what it excludes.

checks.name: It has at least one example query
checks.hint: One worked example teaches Genie more than a paragraph of prose.
